name: terrain_relief
doc: Builds and plans a terrain's ground inside its shape (design/terrain.md): the shape's cells with their sides and openings; relief from the sides' heights inward with hills by the parameters; flats levelled for a planner; rivers carved from inlets to outlets (or a lake); terraced rock and cave mouths; roads joining every road opening and flat, graded and paved, bridged over water with mounts; materials; the ground as hexbound columns of spans in 1/8 m (design/import.hexbound.world.md); a navigation mesh with its report; the boundary's hull; and the plotter's nature ground.
